title: Metaphors We Compute By: A Computational Audit of Cultural Translation vs. Thinking in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting an LLM to generate metaphors for abstract concepts under different cultural personas (U.S., Japan, China, India, Brazil, and a culture-agnostic Default), embedding the generated text, and using geometric analyses (cosine distance and t-SNE) to measure intra-cultural semantic diversity, conceptual clustering, and Western defaultism.
